name: saas-backend
description: Backend SaaS - Sistema de Gestión de Documentos con AWS S3 y DynamoDB

scripts.dev: npm run localstack:up && npm run cdk:deploy:local && npm run test:local
scripts.cdk:synth: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=dev cdk synth --profile saas-maestria
scripts.cdk:synth:local: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=local cdk synth
scripts.cdk:diff:local: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=local cdk diff
scripts.cdk:diff:dev: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=dev cdk diff --profile saas-maestria
scripts.cdk:deploy:local: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=local cdklocal deploy --all --require-approval never
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=dev cdk deploy --profile saas-maestria --all --require-approval never
scripts.cdk:deploy:staging: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=staging cdk deploy --all
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=prod cdk deploy --all
scripts.cdk:destroy:local: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=local cdklocal destroy --all --force
scripts.cdk:destroy:dev: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=dev cdk destroy --all --force
scripts.cdk:bootstrap:local: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=local cdklocal bootstrap
scripts.cdk:bootstrap:dev: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=dev cdk bootstrap --profile saas-maestria
scripts.cdk:list:local: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=local cdk list
scripts.deploy:lambda: cd infra && cross-env ENVIRONMENT=dev cdk deploy SaasBackend-Lambda-dev --profile saas-maestria --require-approval never
